paper_title: Cosmological bounds on pseudo Nambu-Goldstone bosons
notes: This paper is a theoretical review that derives constraints on ALPs from cosmological observables (BBN, CMB, WMAP Neff, primordial abundances, diffuse photon backgrounds) through theoretical modeling. The abstract states 'This paper reviews and complements the previous work of Massó and Toldrá.' These are reinterpretations of existing cosmological observations in the ALP parameter space, not new direct experimental measurements of ALP couplings. The bounds presented in Figures 1 and 2 (mφ−g and mφ−τ parameter spaces) are theoretical constraints, not empirical data points.
